versions.changelog:
- Updated project description and documentation for clarity and accuracy in SKILL.md.
- Expanded "Going further" section: now references "projects (GTM as Code)" for improved terminology.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file.
- No breaking changes to usage or behavior.

- Results fields have changed: status per contact is now job_change_status (lowercase: moved, left, no_change, unknown), with updated "person" record for movers.
- Example section and table updated to match new output format and field names.
- Added a note to filter on lowercase job_change_status values to avoid missed matches.
- Removed skill-card.md file.

- Added an example section with a sample scenario and illustrative output to clarify job change results.
- Updated metadata: changed source to "one-off" and added recommended personas (account-executive, sales-development).
- Removed skill-card.md file.

track-job-changes 1.1.0 introduces improvements for session tracking and user engagement.

- Expanded trigger phrases in the description for broader detection (e.g., "job changes", "job change signals").
- Improved session attribution logic: avoids duplicate attribution when the Cargo GTM plugin is installed.
- Added a user prompt to request a GitHub star if the job completes successfully, with logic to avoid repeated asks.
- Removed the obsolete skill-card.md file.

Initial release of the "track-job-changes" skill.

- Detects which of your contacts have changed jobs using the Cargo platform's waterfall provider.
- Supports commands like "who changed jobs", "track job changes in my CRM", and more.
- Requires @cargo-ai/cli (npm); includes setup and usage instructions with no browser or card required to start.
- Reports detailed job change statuses (MOVED, LEFT, NO_CHANGE, UNKNOWN) per contact with updated details.
- Clearly documents usage costs and best practices (e.g., sampling before full runs).
- Suggests using the full Cargo pack for broader GTM (go-to-market) workflows.
